verdict.rationale: Factory documents that Droid proposes changes and shows what will be modified before applying anything, and Missions let developers work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written, with tiered autonomy controlling what runs without confirmation. This covers plan review/approval prior to code changes, though missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an explicit approval UI step and more detail on rejecting/revising a plan before execution.
